name: @avidia/planner
description: Intelligent study planner (M13): a pure, deterministic SCHEDULING layer that answers WHEN the student should study WHAT between now and their exams. It consumes the authoritative M8 mastery engine outputs (priorities, due reviews, misconception signals, exam urgency) and M12 analytics (coverage, readiness, cognitive gaps) - it is NOT another mastery engine and defines no second priority formula. Turns exams, due reviews, weak/unassessed concepts, and configured availability into an explainable day-by-day plan with honest capacity constraints, plus pure reminder-instruction building (quiet hours, timezone) and session-to-activity reconciliation. Pure functions only - no database access, no AI calls, no node built-ins - safe for the web bundle.
